mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.dept_name AS name, leader.id AS leader_user_id FROM iam_user subject JOIN iam_employee e ON e.tenant_id = subject.tenant_id AND e.id = subject.employee_id AND e.deleted = 0 JOIN iam_department d ON d.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND d.id = e.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN iam_user leader ON leader.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND leader.id = d.leader_user_id AND leader.deleted = 0 AND leader.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE subject.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND subject.id = #{userId} AND subject.deleted = 0 AND subject.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.nickname AS user_name FROM iam_department d JOIN iam_user u ON u.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND u.id = d.leader_user_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.nickname AS user_name FROM iam_user_role ur JOIN iam_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' JOIN iam_user u ON u.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.role_id = #{id} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND (ur.expire_at IS NULL OR ur.expire_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY u.id
SELECT id AS user_id, nickname AS user_name FROM iam_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED'
